about.text: Touch&Skill courses stand for the most professional approach to training and for responsibility towards every patient who ends up in our graduates' hands. We don't just teach massage techniques - we train professionals who easily find their first clients and quickly reach a stable income
about.imageAlt: Touch&Skill tutor explaining anatomy on a training poster

parents.title: Courses for parents
parents.intro: These are one-to-one sessions for parents of infants or of children with disabilities, where they learn specific exercise routines and other recommendations to follow at home
parents.first: First of all, these sessions help parents overcome the fear of touching their own child (which is quite common), as well as the stereotype that such exercises only happen in a clinic with specialists
parents.second: Second, fewer visits to specialists save both time and the family budget.
parents.third: Third, the knowledge and recommendations they gain stay with them for good.

guide.title: Manual
guide.text: The textbook "Manual for Massage Therapists. A Practical Author's Guide" is written for students, beginners and practicing massage therapists who want to deepen or refresh their knowledge and improve their practical skills. It sets out the core massage techniques, the anatomical and physiological basis of each procedure, indications and contraindications, and the specifics of working with different client groups - clearly and in a structured way. The material reflects current requirements for health and rehabilitation professionals. Special attention is paid to anatomy, with clear color illustrations for a thorough study of the theory. The textbook can be used as core reading for massage courses as well as for self-study
